selection.design: SHA-256 ranking of seed, stratum and sorted identity fields; lowest ranks selected without replacement before decoding or decompilation.

results.inference: Exploratory local code/API-change rate in the eligible shared-C-function frame. Not the rate of changed gameplay, nor a total remaining-recovery estimate. Wilson intervals cover sampling uncertainty under the review labels, not classification errors, unpaired functions or indirect callee/data changes.

assessment.copy_caller_change: The old ECX=0 is special_flags3, not special_flags. The old special_flags is a DWARF constant 0xc0000. The new worker restores that physical argument and adds forced_target=NULL. Do not count the ECX literal difference as a new flag behavior.
assessment.show_deck_limitation: Unmapped native tail jump causes halt_baddata in raw C. The assembly independently shows a new zero store to hack_show_deck_force_expansion before show_deck_exe.

limitations: No selection by size/similarity and no replacement of hard functions; seed and frame frozen before decoding.
Only unambiguously paired C functions are in the frame; known pilot entries and catalogued recovered target entries are excluded.
Same local instructions or corresponding C does not prove unchanged callee/data behavior.
Raw C has unresolved optimized parameter locations and incomplete native call models. Assembly and DWARF are used to resolve or qualify claims.
Code/API changes include display changes, optional arguments and event filters; they are not all new card effects or bug fixes.
